name: Previously returned original relic recovered from Free Cities by Core deal

condition.code:
local stage=Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_AI_MOVE_PROBE')
if not stage or stage.Stage~='FREE_CUSTODY_PROVED' then return false end
local free=CityManager.GetCityAt(stage.Carrier.X,stage.Carrier.Y)
local human=CityManager.GetCityAt(129,35)
return free and free:GetOwner()==stage.Carrier.Free and free:GetID()==stage.Carrier.FreeCity
 and free:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(stage.Carrier.Building,stage.Carrier.Slot)==stage.Index
 and human and human:GetOwner()==1 and human:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(12,0)==-1

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local stage=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_AI_MOVE_PROBE'))
assert(stage.Stage=='FREE_CUSTODY_PROVED','same original work was not proved in Free Cities')
local found=A.NativeWorkLocations(stage.Index)
assert(#found==1 and found[1].Owner==stage.Carrier.Free and found[1].CityID==stage.Carrier.FreeCity
 and found[1].X==stage.Carrier.X and found[1].Y==stage.Carrier.Y
 and found[1].Building==stage.Carrier.Building and found[1].Slot==stage.Carrier.Slot,'Free Cities original work location changed')
local reads=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroReadAPI)
local slots=reads.FindCompatibleNativeSlots(1,found[1].ObjectType)
assert(#slots==1 and slots[1].Owner==1 and slots[1].City==196610 and slots[1].X==129 and slots[1].Y==35 and slots[1].Building==12 and slots[1].Slot==0,'human recovery Temple not exactly empty')
local from,to=stage.Carrier.Free,1
local deal=assert(DealManager.GetWorkingDeal(DealDirection.OUTGOING,from,to))
assert(deal:GetItemCount()==0,'Free Cities recovery working deal contains another item')
local choices=DealManager.GetPossibleDealItems(from,to,DealItemTypes.GREATWORK,deal)
local candidate
for _,item in ipairs(choices or {}) do if item.ForType==stage.Index then candidate=item end end
assert(candidate and candidate.IsValid,'Free Cities original work is not a valid recovery item')
local subtype=assert(GameInfo.GreatWorks[found[1].GreatWorkType]).Index
local item=assert(deal:AddItemOfType(DealItemTypes.GREATWORK,from))
item:SetSubType(subtype);item:SetValueType(stage.Index)
deal:Validate();assert(deal:IsValid(),'Free Cities original recovery deal invalid')
local proof={Index=stage.Index,Source={Owner=stage.Carrier.Free,City=stage.Carrier.FreeCity,X=stage.Carrier.X,Y=stage.Carrier.Y,Building=stage.Carrier.Building,Slot=stage.Carrier.Slot},Target=slots[1],Original=stage.Source,Stage='SENT'}
Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_RECOVER_PROBE',proof)
local result=DealManager.EnactWorkingDeal(from,to)
print('[JAC_NATIVE_FREE_RECOVER_SEND] index='..stage.Index..' result='..tostring(result))
return 'Free Cities original work recovery submitted; physical check follows'

local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_RECOVER_PROBE'))
local free=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Source.X,plan.Source.Y))
local human=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.Target.X,plan.Target.Y))
local src=free:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Source.Building,plan.Source.Slot)
local dst=human:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Target.Building,plan.Target.Slot)
local count=0;local found
local owners,seen={},{}
for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do if not seen[owner] then owners[#owners+1]=owner;seen[owner]=true end end
if not seen[plan.Source.Owner] then owners[#owners+1]=plan.Source.Owner end
for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do local p=Players[owner];if p then for _,city in p:GetCities():Members() do
 local b=city:GetBuildings();for def in GameInfo.Buildings() do if b:HasBuilding(def.Index) then
  for slot=0,b:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(def.Index)-1 do if b:GetGreatWorkInSlot(def.Index,slot)==plan.Index then count=count+1;found={Owner=owner,City=city:GetID(),X=city:GetX(),Y=city:GetY(),Building=def.Index,Slot=slot} end end
 end end end end end
ExposedMembers.JAC_FreeRecoverPhysical={Count=count,Source=src,Dest=dst,Found=found}
print('[JAC_NATIVE_FREE_RECOVER_PHYSICAL] count='..count..' source='..tostring(src)..' dest='..tostring(dst)..' foundOwner='..tostring(found and found.Owner))
return 'Free Cities original recovery physical scan count='..count

local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_RECOVER_PROBE'))
local proof=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_FreeRecoverPhysical)
assert(proof.Count==1 and proof.Source==-1 and proof.Dest==plan.Index,'original Free Cities work did not recover to human Temple')
local w=assert(proof.Found);local t=plan.Target
assert(w.Owner==t.Owner and w.City==t.City and w.X==t.X and w.Y==t.Y and w.Building==t.Building and w.Slot==t.Slot,'original recovered work missed exact human Temple')
return 'same original index physically recovered from Free Cities to human Temple'

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_RECOVER_PROBE'))
local found=A.NativeWorkLocations(plan.Index)
assert(#found==1 and found[1].Owner==plan.Target.Owner and found[1].CityID==plan.Target.City
 and found[1].X==plan.Target.X and found[1].Y==plan.Target.Y
 and found[1].Building==plan.Target.Building and found[1].Slot==plan.Target.Slot,'Core original index recovery location changed')
for _,key in ipairs({'GreatWorkType','ObjectType','CreatorName','TurnCreated','CreatedByPlayer'}) do assert(plan.Original[key]==found[1][key],'original recovered metadata changed: '..key) end
assert(A.Rules.Equal(plan.Original.Effects,found[1].Effects),'original recovered effects changed')
plan.Stage='PROVED';Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_RECOVER_PROBE',plan)
print('[JAC_NATIVE_FREE_RECOVER_PROVED] '..A.Canonical(plan))
return 'same original index and metadata survived Free Cities recovery'
